name: Model Architecture Training Sidecar
description: A non-destructive training-semantics overlay for the canonical model-architecture-3d-deck right view, with four-stream mHC state flow, backward activation gradients, explicit microbatch/step parameter-gradient lifecycles, configured optimizer synchronization, loss composition, metric strips, selectable Layer focus lenses, and click-through annotation inspectors.

source.visualContract: The canonical side view remains owned by model-architecture-3d-deck. This pattern reads projected DOM bounds and adds sibling SVG/DOM overlays without redefining base nodes, colors, FFN bands, or projection math. In the collapsed right view, each Decoder Layer owns one narrow full-model-height hit strip in a dedicated SVG interaction layer above operator annotations; clicking anywhere on that vertical strip selects the Layer, while operator details become clickable only inside the expanded Layer. A selected Layer may request a temporary symmetric depth gap through the base renderer's public setLayerExpansion API; the selected Layer remains at its canonical coordinate, surrounding Layers move apart, and collapsing restores the exact default geometry. The expanded Layer renders its real openPangu operator rows in semantic order. Operator names are the only row labels: do not add redundant operator-type pills. Telemetry follows an object-specific schema: tensors show distributions, parameter operators show weight/step-gradient/update, communication shows payload/bandwidth/latency, Router shows Pmax/entropy/imbalance, Norm shows input/output RMS, and Residual/mHC shows norm delta and stream mixing. The selected Layer shows H_l x4 to Attention Mix/Merge to H_l-prime x4 to FFN Mix/Merge to H_l+1 x4; never replace mHC with two standard Transformer identity/Add paths or invent an unverified fusion matrix. True local Residual Add rows may use a plus marker; generic mHC Merge rows are never marked as standard addition. Selected attention labels come from controller config and distinguish SWA window semantics from DSA sparse-global semantics while listing FlashAttention separately as a kernel. Stage ranges and layer count come from controller config; rank labels appear only when options.topology.rankGroups exists, otherwise only configured parallel dimensions are shown. Main CE receives shifted target labels, and Main CE, Router Aux, and MTP losses feed an explicit Total Training Loss composition whose unknown coefficients remain training-job configured. Microbatch gradient contribution and step-accumulated gradient are distinct objects; only the latter feeds configured DP Gradient Sync and the optimizer. In the sidecar preview, the base right-edge operator legend is disabled through its public showSideLabels option and replaced by projected per-row bands. In right-view PP mode, redundant in-model PP pills are hidden only within the sidecar; full-height PP boundaries and Send/Recv annotations remain visible. The canvas is container-driven; narrow containers use a bottom Layer Inspector drawer. Model depth is represented only by Layer numbers and faint vertical alignment guides. Per-Layer Std sigma, Amax, and latency are rendered as aligned small-multiple line charts. Forward and backward lanes and chevrons share one high-contrast neutral flow color in both themes; residual rails remain purple in dark mode and switch to neutral gray in light mode. Side-view panning uses a compositor-transform drag fast path, and structural projected bounds are cached between telemetry-only updates.
source.focusLayoutContract: The expanded Layer Inspector clones the selected Layer's canonical front-view graph DOM from model-architecture-3d-deck, preserving its Attention and FFN/MoE clusters and branch topology without maintaining a second operator inventory. Focus nodes use one compact normalized operator box size, with a smaller strict circle for Add and a slightly wider mHC state box. Q and KV operators each occupy one strict vertical axis, and the two axes use a compact symmetric gap around the graph center. Object-specific telemetry is overlaid as a compact second line inside each real operator node; Add nodes retain only the plus glyph and expose metrics through the shared detail interaction. Focus-view dependency edges are neutral rather than operator-colored, Shared Expert merge routing stays outside the Combine path, and the four-stream mHC residual/state path is rendered as four parallel rails. Residual Add uses a solid theme-aware fill: purple in dark mode and neutral gray in light mode. Router Aux and Backward footer labels remain readable at the final rendered scale. The cloned graph is scaled as one unit to the container-driven panel, with a responsive bottom drawer on narrow containers. Global Loss composition lives in a dedicated slot below the LM Head/logits output tail and training lanes, never over the Layer metric tracks, and yields to an open Layer Inspector instead of appearing partially occluded behind it.
evidence: Megatron Core pipeline parallelism and bridge communicator documentation
Megatron distributed parameter/gradient buffer and optimizer documentation

telemetryRule: Snapshots include step, microbatch, stage, layer, tensorName, tensors, and explicit optimizer/weight-version context. Rank is optional and may appear only when a real rank or rankGroups mapping is supplied. Softmax logits and probabilities remain distinct. gradientContribution belongs to one microbatch; accumulatedGradient, optimizer state, and weight versions belong to an optimizer step. The visual does not render provenance rows or source badges.
forbiddenOverrides: Do not edit or restyle model-architecture-3d-deck internals from this pattern.
Do not relabel the real L0-L45 Decoder stack as a generic 48-layer stack.
Do not draw parameter gradients as the backward inter-layer transport.
Do not add provenance rows or source badges inside the visualization.
Do not replace source-validated openPangu operators with a generic Transformer stack.
agentReuseRule: Load model-graphviz, then model-architecture-3d-deck, then this sidecar. Call PtoModelArchitectureTrainingSidecar.render. Extend training data and the layer-detail slot without copying or changing the base deck renderer. Every added sidecar annotation must use the shared tip/detail metadata contract so it remains hoverable and opens the inspector; metrics must include a definition, current value, reference range, status assessment, and execution context.
